text: A deceased member of your family who is in heaven has asked me to deliver a very important
message to you. If your answer is yes, accept it and watch this video until the end.
This person is in paradise, surrounded by peace and light. They asked me to deliver
the following message. But first, send this video to yourself as a confirmation.
Now click on my profile picture and go watch my stories before they disappear.
The message is waiting for you right there. Blessings.
